function.name: knowledge_base_retrieve
function.description: Retrieve grounding data from the organisation's knowledge base. Returns ranked source documents with IDs, dates and content. Use focused queries and call again for additional topics.

function.name: ask
function.description: Ask a question about workplace information such as messages, exceptions, clearances and notices. Returns matching items; a match is not an approval, so check each item's scope and dates.

question.description: Natural-language question, naming the supplier, product or topic.

function.name: search_ontology
function.description: Answer a natural-language question from the business ontology, which holds business entities and their current state. Returns raw results in JSON format.
